CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( ISBLANK(Last_Purchase_Date__c), ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) > 0 ), "High",
IF( AND( Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c > 0, ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) >= (1.5 * Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c) ), "High",
IF( AND( ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) > Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c, Days_Since_Last_WHL_Order__c >= 30 ), "High",
IF( AND( ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) > Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c, Days_Since_Last_WHL_Order__c >= 15 ), "Mid",
IF( ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) > Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c, "Low", NULL ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: WHL Gap Severity
